title: Asks for card or net banking details
why: Real banks already have your card details. A message asking you to send or confirm them is collecting them to spend your money.
examples: Please confirm your debit card number and expiry date to avoid blocking.
Enter your net banking password and card details at the link to continue.
safe: Do not share your card details with anyone.
Your credit card ending 4821 was used for Rs 450 at BigBasket.
